text: will u on the iso 3d make it so when i click on something i can rotate with r. i can only rotate before place
resolution: Click-then-R now rotates placed things in the iso pane. The blocker was the armed brush: after placing, the piece stayed armed, so every click placed ANOTHER copy and R turned the ghost — placed objects were unreachable without knowing Esc. Fixes: (1) R is selection-first — a live selection rotates even while a piece is armed; the ghost only gets R when nothing is selected. (2) shift-click while armed SELECTS the piece under the cursor instead of placing (Alt stays freeform-place; the hint bar advertises the chord), and placing clears stale selections. (3) Rotation keeps the selection — a rotated loose piece gets a fresh stream id from remove+place, so the pane re-acquires it by placement signature, meaning R,R,R turns the same prop 270° without re-clicking. Hot reload picks it up.
